title: Embedded C^r submanifolds are a local notion, and open pieces have the same tangent spaces (parent step 2, F2)
statement: Let P, r, d ∈ ℕ with r ≥ 1 and let M ⊆ ℝ^P. Suppose every y ∈ M has an open O ∋ y such that M ∩ O is an embedded d-dimensional C^r submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d (M ∩ O)). Then (a) M is an embedded d-dimensional C^r submanifold, and (b) for every open O ⊆ ℝ^P, M ∩ O is an embedded d-dimensional C^r submanifold and tangentSpace (M ∩ O) w = tangentSpace M w for every w ∈ M ∩ O. IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d N means: every y ∈ N has open V ⊆ ℝ^d, open W ∋ y and ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P, C^r and injective on V, with ψ(V) = W ∩ N, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) compact for every compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ(z) injective for z ∈ V. tangentSpace N w is the set of velocities γ'(0) of curves γ that are C¹ on (−1, 1) with γ((−1, 1)) ⊆ N and γ(0) = w.
lean_statement: ∀ (P r d : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ r → (∀ y ∈ M, ∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ y ∈ O ∧ IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d (M ∩ O)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d M ∧ ∀ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d (M ∩ O) ∧ ∀ w ∈ M ∩ O, tangentSpace (M ∩ O) w = tangentSpace M w
